checks_run.procedure: Check F-DG1-137/218 independently, end to end on disk, with a reviewer-authored probe. Plant real declaration files in src/modules/kpi in the classic forms (.d.ts/.d.mts/.d.cts) and the allowArbitraryExtensions forms (.d.css.ts/.d.json.ts/.d.ts.ts/.d.html.ts), then lint them through the public moduleViolations() entry point, which uses walk(). D2 is a deep cross-module TYPE import, D3 a composition-root import, D4 a syntax error and D5 a clean file followed by its removal. D6 is a non-declaration look-alike (.dx.ts) with a deep import. As a negative control, run the same probe against the round-15 (f27b5a6) architecture.testkit.ts. Remove the probe and restore the testkit afterwards.

The classic forms and D6 pass there too. This reproduces the original defect and shows that the fix removes it with no boundary-coverage gap. The clone was clean after restore.

The round-15 testkit crashes with Debug Failure on exactly those 16 cases. The change is test-only. Unit 325/325, architecture 132/132 and integration 200/200 pass on Node 22 and on Node 24.
